reviews.name: Ressie Daileg
reviews.text: Finding Jesse felt like fate. As first time home buyers, Jesse and Yesenia made the entire process incredibly fast and easy. He is very honest and has a deep understanding in the local market. He knew the area very well and provided great advice. We cannot thank him enough for being there for us until the end and celebrating with us on closing our first home.

reviews.name: Marisol Rivera
reviews.text: Shout out to our Home Buying DREAM TEAM Yesenia & Jesse!Seriously, if you ever considered home owning, hit up these two wonderful and AMAZING human beings! They’ll take the best care of you & educate you on this super complex process! I had committed to the idea of being a renter for life, and hated away from any home owning conversations thinking it was never gonna happen for me. And honestly, my husband and I couldn’t have walked away from this process excited, joyous, and sure without both Yesenia & Jesse.You know you’ve got the best team when they are genuinely keeping an ear and eye open for what they know works for us—in regards to lenders, programs, actual homes, neighborhoods, etc. Jesse literally was checking in on us for months before we seriously started applying for anything, just making sure we were on the right track, cleared up any questions, and provided the motivation we sometimes lacked within ourselves. Thank you so much, Jesse & Yesenia 🥹♥️✊🏽

reviews.name: jose malvaez
reviews.text: Jesse introduced my wife and I to his team! Him and his team helped us with this amazing process of buying our first property! It is truly an incredibly experience that I will never forget. He is patient, my wife and I got introduced to him, he manifested us buying a home at a certain time, and it happened. He will go above and beyond for not only his clients, but everyone involved in the process. I highly recommend him if you want to make this an unforgettable experience

reviews.name: Nuris Marroquin
reviews.text: Jesse was a great person and very helpful in this process! He was very patient and very opened hearted. If you ever looking for  someone to help you in the process of finding a home Jesse is your person!!!

reviews.name: Tiffany Huezo
reviews.text: He is the best agent I have ever worked with. He really cares about his clients and goes above and beyond for them. I found my home buying experience was fast and smooth, he kept a calm and professional demeanor that made me feel reassured.

reviews.name: akshay shinde
reviews.text: Jesse helped us buying our first home in LA! He was patient and attentive with our needs and wants. He always made himself available to clarify any doubts or concerns throughout the process. He made the entire process super easy and convenient. Best realtor in LA. Definitely recommend Jesse and his team!

reviews.name: Jessica Ruiz
reviews.text: I can’t express how thankful and grateful we are for Jesse.He always made himself available and was very patient with all our questions.He is someone who my family and I  will never forget. My 3 year old still asks “when can  mr Jesse come over to our new house.”From the bottom of my heart thank him for helping us thru this journey, we were truly in good hands.

reviews.name: Kikai Sanabria
reviews.text: By far the best decision me and my fiancé made, was to chose Jesse as our realtor.He made the process not only a breeze but enjoyable as well. Finding a home can be stressful but Jesse was always there to ease any of our anxiety and answer any questions we had. He’s patient, kind and everything you could hope to find in a great realtor, We definitely recommend him to anyone who’s looking to embark on this new journey of home ownership . :)

reviews.name: Myrah Mercado
reviews.text: I have worked with a number of agents and Jesse was truly the most patient, positive and available agent I have worked with.  I will definitely work with him again. Thank you for everything!

reviews.name: Sharon Lopez
reviews.text: Jesse is knowledgeable,kind and always so thoughtful and pleasant.

reviews.name: Mr. Cypress Real Estate
reviews.text: You want to talk about a go-getter? Jessie is your man. He looks after his clients like no other. We worked together for our clients and he was always quick to respond and addressed any issues. Looking forward to the next one Jessie.-Mr. Cypress Real Estate

reviews.name: Christopher Perez
reviews.text: After several real estate agents, I had lost hope in finding a house. I was referred to Jesse by a good friend of my wife and I. Jesse would ask us about the house we seen to see what we liked and did not like to look for other houses with out likes and dislikes in mind. Jesse was able to find us a house very soon after looking at several homes. Jesse was able to help get our offer accepted and close escrow within a month. I would definitely recommend Jesse!

reviews.name: Patricia Quintana
reviews.text: You need a realtor? Jesse is your #1 guy for that.. he will definitely make your experience run smoothly any questions you have he’s there to answer every single one of them.  You won’t be disappointed with choosing him to help you buy/sale your house.  Pick him to be your realtor.

reviews.name: Edgar Valdovinos
reviews.text: Jesse and his team have gone  above and beyond to help my parents start the home buying process. His team has been fantastic in explaining everything step by step, although we are still looking for our first home, I cannot wait for us to close on our first deal.

reviews.name: Mario Bros
reviews.text: Jesse was there from beginning to end. Made the the whole process of purchasing a home easy. Granted, the looking for a home part took a while but once we found it he guided us on every step required and that really made us all feel at ease. He always answered his phone for us and no question was ever left unanswered. Jesse and his team work well and cover all bases in the home buying and selling industry. I will definitely keep him in mind for friends and family who may be looking to buy or sell. Thanks again Jesse!

reviews.name: Andrew Phan
reviews.text: Jesse is a great realtor! He helps helps clients whether it’s a buyer or seller in their best interest! I would definitely recommend him!

reviews.name: victor morales
reviews.text: Purchased my first home with Jesse and him and his team made this process extremely easy. His communication and ability to understand mine and my family needs over exceeded my expectations. Since then, I have recommended multiple other buyers to him and I myself will not make another property purchase without Jesse and his team.

reviews.name: Jennifer Flores
reviews.text: #1 Realtor!!I have worked with several other realtors in the past and no one compares to Jesse! I found Jesse's business card at an open house and immediately contacted him. He immediately reached out to me to say hello and inquire about my home buying needs. During our first meet and greet, he explained his process to me and I could immediately see that he is passionate about this field. Jesse is hardworking, goes ABOVE AND BEYOND, and is a sincere and genuine realtor/person. You can tell Jesse truly wants the best for his clients (no car salesman vibe here).Jesse was extremely patient with me and my indecisiveness as we shopped for a few months. Every time I sent Jesse a home I was interested in, he would respond quickly and often times we'd go see the house that same day!Jesse made this process easy, fun and memorable. I recommend him 110%!!
